# Schlüsselmacher24 - Automated Auditing & Architecture Matrix

This project employs a systematic, 4-phase transformation process driven by specialized agents.
Currently, the codebase has been audited by `JC-AUDITOR-ARCHITECT-v1`.

### Auditing Summary:
- Existing Routes: 49
- All audited routes have been mapped in `.jules/architecture-matrix.md`.
- Deep integration rules have been formulated into `.jules/revolution-plan.json`.

**Blueprint Goals:**
- Eliminating Thin Content: Enforcing >800 word counts across all routes.
- Elevating Interactions: Planning specific widgets like ROI calculators and bento-boxes.
- Strict Swiss Light Mode design adherence.
